tasks.title: Methods card for a group paper
tasks.subtitle: Reads the paper's passages and writes a methods summary where every claim is cited
tasks.prompt: Pulls the passages of one group paper from the paper index, then an agent on Modal writes a methods card (system, simulation and experimental methods, analysis, limitations) in which every claim cites its source as [n].

tasks.title: Ion–water binding, computed live
tasks.subtitle: Runs a real DFT calculation on Modal and writes it up as a cited manuscript, revised live as the numbers arrive
tasks.prompt: A research agent on Modal scans the distance between an ion and a water molecule with DFT (PySCF), computes the counterpoise-corrected binding energy and compares it with full and charge-scaled (ECC) point charges. It keeps a lab notebook of what it tried and what was slow, and drafts a manuscript early (equations, a figure, citations of the group's papers), then revises it as each result arrives.
